description: Create the AD ITSELF on LinkedIn — a CREATIVE inside an existing campaign. A LinkedIn campaign holds no copy and no visual, so until this runs the campaign CANNOT show an impression no matter what its status says; say that rather than calling a campaign "live". Two ways in: pass postUrn to sponsor a post that already exists (LinkedIn’s "boost this post"), or pass text and/or imageUrl / videoUrl / documentUrl (a PDF/PPTX/DOCX document ad) to author a DIRECT SPONSORED CONTENT post — a real post by a company Page the user administers that is NEVER shown on the Page’s feed and exists only as an ad. Created DRAFT: it spends nothing until you activate it with set_linkedin_ads_status(level:"creative", status:"ACTIVE", confirm:true). Creating it ACTIVE under an already-live campaign starts REAL AD SPEND on the very next auction and therefore requires confirm:true. LEAD GEN ADS: under a LEAD_GENERATION campaign pass leadFormId (create_linkedin_lead_form makes one) — LinkedIn requires it there. The whole tree — group, campaign and every creative — is read back from LinkedIn before you are told anything exists.

adAccountId.description: LinkedIn ad account id shared with this profile; needed only when several are shared

allowReshare.description: true lets viewers reshare the sponsored post; default false (reshare disabled)

altText.description: image alt text for accessibility, for a single-image ad

callToAction.description: the BUTTON on the ad (contentCallToActionLabel) — needs landingPage. Omit for no button.

campaignId.description: the campaign this ad belongs to

confirm.description: REQUIRED true to create it ACTIVE under a LIVE campaign (real spend)

documentUrl.description: DOCUMENT AD: a PDF / PPTX / DOCX shown as a swipeable document in the feed — Hermoso-hosted, so upload_file it first

gatedPreviewPages.description: document ad under a LEAD_GENERATION campaign only: pages shown free before the lead form unlocks the rest

imageUrl.description: a Hermoso-hosted image to attach — a render, or the user’s OWN creative put through upload_file first (an arbitrary external host is refused)

landingPage.description: WHERE THE AD SENDS THE CLICK — a full https URL, sent as LinkedIn’s contentLandingPage. REQUIRED when the campaign objective is WEBSITE_VISIT (refused here, for free, without it). Only for a NEW sponsored post: an existing postUrn keeps its own link.

leadButton.description: the lead gen button label, default LEARN_MORE (UNLOCK_FULL_DOCUMENT for a gated document)

leadFormId.description: LEAD GEN ADS: the lead gen form this ad opens. REQUIRED under a LEAD_GENERATION campaign and refused under any other objective

name.description: the creative’s name in Campaign Manager

organizationId.description: the company Page that authors the Direct Sponsored Content post; omit only when the connection administers exactly one Page

postUrn.description: Sponsor an EXISTING post — urn:li:share:… / urn:li:ugcPost:…

title.description: title of an uploaded document or video ad (max 200 characters)

videoUrl.description: a Hermoso-hosted video to attach — a render, or the user’s own footage via upload_file

name: create_linkedin_ads_creative
title: Create a LinkedIn ad (creative, draft)
